hook: Clear communication adds 27% more trust to AI teamwork.

sections.voiceover: Clear communication adds 27% more trust to AI teamwork.
Purdue University surveyed 1,200 professionals on AI‑mediated teamwork trust. And 78% of managers view communication as the key AI skill—why?
But teams with strong communication experienced 34% fewer errors.
Purdue found that clear communication cuts operational mistakes by 34% in AI teams. So boosting communication not only builds trust, it saves costly failures.
